_annotation.name: Team Members (team.json)
_annotation.what: Team members data with names, roles, bios, photos, and social links. Displays the people behind the business to build trust with visitors. Shared across both ES and EN sites (hence _shared/).
_annotation.why: People buy from people they trust. A professional team section with real faces, roles, and specialties makes your business feel legitimate and approachable — not like a faceless website.
_annotation.ai_popolates: Names and roles: From your team roster (send via WhatsApp). Bios: AI generates from your team members' stated experience and specialties. Photos: AI optimizes your provided photos (crop to circle, compress for web). Instagram links: Auto-linked from your provided handles.
_annotation.your_input: Send us your team members' names, roles, 2-sentence bios, and 3 specialty keywords each. Plus 1 photo per person.
_annotation.plan: All plans — Professional tier adds animated entrance effects

description: Team members data with names, roles, bios, photos, and social links. Displays the people behind the business to build trust with visitors. AI populates this from the entrepreneur's team information.
